carmen: Heads-up: 01:05-01:20 UTC we saw enrichment vendor 504s; ~312 web leads dropped into manual_fallback. SDRs pinged. @sam @maria

sam: Can you paste the log line?

carmen: ```POST /v1/enrich 504 2026-04-02T01:08:13Z payload={contact: 'C_999'} latency=30012ms```

maria: Because HS gate requires `enriched=true` these go to manual triage owner. Bad for SLAs.

raj: Propose quick steps: A) bump claim_window 5m->11m overnight B) run backfill C) temporary RR override when `lead_score >= 70` and `source='web'`. Which now?

sam: Do (B) and (A). Backfill first.

ops-bot: ops-bot: change request set `claim_window_seconds=660` for workspace `marketing-intake` 00:00-06:00 UTC. Need approval.

maria: Approved. I'll add an audit tag `hotfix_enrich_override=true` for any temp assignments.

leadflow-bot: leadflow-bot: backfill queued (job bf-20260402-01) dry-run matched 312. Proceed?

sam: Proceed.

leadflow-bot: leadflow-bot: backfill bf-20260402-01 completed: reassigned=305, 7 retryable failures. Logs uploaded.

carmen: Nice. Raj, can you add a Prom rule for enrichment failure rate >0.4% over 15m to fire a low PD? We need to catch this before customers notice owner gaps.

raj: On it. Also adding a dashboard panel for fallback_queue_rate so marketing can watch.

maria: I'll run a SF reconcile tomorrow AM for any records that synced as `manual_fallback`. Posting CSV to the team bucket.

carmen: Thanks team. Follow-ups in retro: client retries for enrich calls, vendor SLA request, and a plan to make routing less dependent on enrichment for basic owner assignment.
